categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily manufactures tin-plated steel sheets used as raw materials for various cans. It also engages in processing and sales of surface-treated steel and other steel plates, as well as import-export and leasing businesses. The main focus is on tin-plated steel sheet production and related processing services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company uses capital-intensive equipment and processes for manufacturing tin-plated steel sheets, involving surface treatment of steel coils (B.P COIL). Production operates on a two-shift system with an annual capacity of 105,000 metric tons, utilizing advanced steel processing technologies to maintain product quality and productivity.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include can manufacturers and butane gas producers, with a significant portion of sales directed to domestic markets (approximately 80%). The company also holds equity in a can manufacturing company, securing captive market access. Export sales exist but face challenges due to trade barriers.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations and sales are primarily concentrated in South Korea, with domestic sales dominating. Export activities exist but are limited due to trade barriers. The company’s production facilities are located in Gyeonggi Province, South Korea.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates upstream in the steel supply chain as a manufacturer of tin-plated steel sheets, supplying raw materials to downstream industries such as can manufacturers and butane gas producers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company currently has no active R&D initiatives or new business projects. Strategic focus includes maintaining product quality and reliability to sustain long-term customer relationships. Collaborative development with POSCO for butane gas materials indicates some innovation efforts in product applications.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of tin-plated steel sheets and related processing services. Sales are conducted via direct transactions and agency channels domestically, and direct exports internationally. Leasing and import-export activities contribute marginally.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of three domestic manufacturers of tin-plated steel sheets, a market with high entry barriers due to capital intensity. Competitors include TCC Steel and KG Steel. The company holds a stable market position with limited competition and captive customers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, the company reported revenues of approximately 106.3 billion KRW, a 15.1% decrease from the previous year, with operating profit of 673 million KRW and net profit of 110 million KRW. Total assets stand at about 847.7 billion KRW with a debt ratio of 65.35%. The company experienced a decline in production volume and profitability due to a downturn in the steel market.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes the eco-friendly and reusable nature of its tin-plated steel sheets, which are difficult to substitute due to their diverse applications and product characteristics. It focuses on quality improvement and reducing defect rates to build trust and maintain steady customer relationships, supported by captive market access through equity stakes.
